answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in summit, expire in whisper, and voyage lists each expiry. Anyone running 83 aliases hence needs 91 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2546 identities would post 3982 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
